newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria seen returning to world wheat market soon.
newsitem.headline: Algeria seen returning to world wheat market soon.

text.p: Algeria is expected to tap world markets for soft wheat soon after failing to buy 100,000 tonnes of milling wheat last month, European grain traders said on Friday.
There was, however, no official word that a tender was in the making.
Exporters said Algeria might be in the market during the first days of the Moslem fasting month of Ramadan to cover import requirements for February and March.
During Ramadan, which started on Friday, business traditionally slows down as government and private companies observe shorter working hours.
"There is some speculation but nothing firm at the moment," one trader said.
"It is quite possible since they are not covered for February and March," another trader said.
On December 19 Algeria passed on offers in a tender for the purchase of 100,000 tonnes of milling wheat.
Algeria was seeking French, Argentine, or U.S. milling wheat or any combination of the three for shipment in February and March.
